basics.name: Daniel Manzela
basics.label: Founding AI Product Builder
basics.summary:
Founding AI Product Builder. 6 years of production AI, 9 years of
full-stack engineering. Co-founded TNG Shopper in 2024 — building
and leading the production multi-agent system that powers an AI
content + AI-Search visibility platform for multi-location brands.
Author of Antigravity-OS, an open-source orchestration infra that
lets a small team ship more product per engineer, safely (PyPI: ag-os).

work.name: TNG Shopper
work.summary: Built and led a 7-node multi-agent content pipeline serving 11 enterprise retailers across 5 countries, processing ~10.5M product detail pages per month at $0.0006/page with 68.9% O-R-A-V deterministic pass rate.
highlights: Raised $500K from top-tier angels; $223K Booked / $1.53M Contracted ARR
74% of commits over 18 months as 1 of 2 engineers on the production pipeline
Sole engineer on the front-end platform (ideation → production in <1 month, demo: youtu.be/czZsPbylC1M)
Led WP-multisite team of 3 across 234 managed websites
Within TNG: Elysium research product (11 specialized agents, 15 patent claims, 13 enterprise brands across 15,600+ store locations)

work.name: Tasko AI
work.summary: WhatsApp-native AI errand assistant for paying clients — production agentic system before the term agentic entered industry use. Trained from 21M+ real WhatsApp messages and 9 years of conversation history.
highlights: 21,102 ML-labeled tasks across 153 unique paying clients
Four-layer pipeline: Classify → Retrieve → Execute → Verify
